title: The Jubilee of Sleeping Trains
description: Once a year the railway goes quiet. At sunrise, a caretaker tucks the last engine under its quilt while mist settles over the empty tracks.
alt: A caretaker pulls a striped quilt over a steam locomotive on a railway turntable. Three covered engines rest in a brick roundhouse beside a misty valley at sunrise.
pairing: An imagined railway holiday × steam locomotives tucked in for sleep
